verdict.rationale: Fly.io's official CLI, flyctl, is documented for creating and deploying apps. Running `fly launch` from the project directory creates, configures and (for most apps) deploys the app, so no web dashboard is needed. Community hands-on reports of flaky container pushes and stuck deploys concern reliability, not whether CLI deployment exists, so they lower quality rather than the verdict. Missing for 10: documentation of the repeat-deploy workflow beyond the initial `fly launch`, and independent corroboration of reliable CLI deploys (users report frequent push failures and stuck deploys).

support.subject: As a developer, I can deploy my project directly from the command line without using a web dashboard

citations.quote: Run `fly launch` from inside your project source directory to create, configure, and (for most apps) deploy a new application.
You’ll use the `fly` command to create and deploy apps, manage Machines and volumes, configure networking, and more.
Ship from GitHub or our CLI with `fly launch`.
